title: Hidden Garden – the zone
note: The input of the world pipeline (docs/09 'World pipeline'). The concept gives the look and the vocabulary, never the layout or the scale: scripts/world_map.py generates a different playable map for every seed, sized to the hero's real moves, and writes world.json beside this file.
style: LOOK: detailed hi-bit pixel art with a fine 2-pixel grain, the warm autumn palette and low golden light of the first image (the Hidden Garden): rusty blue-green girders overgrown with vines and orange leaves, golden reeds, a still pond with reflections, mossy stone and earth, warm lanterns in dark caves, a hazy far pine forest. Strict side view, an architect's elevation: everything runs parallel to the screen, nothing recedes. Depth in clear layers behind the play layer: sky, a hazy far tree line, mid trees. The hero is about 76 px tall in this image, so a doorway is about 110 px tall and a ladder rung step about 12 px. TONE: secret horror - calm and pretty first. No text, no logos, no UI.
people: No people, no animals, no plush toys and no characters of any kind: this is an empty stage the game puts its characters into.

vocabulary.above: high in the air above the pond: long rusty blue-green girder beams and bridges with vines and orange leaves hanging from them, ladders between them, the tops of autumn trees, open sky with small clouds above a hazy far forest
vocabulary.level: the level of the pond: grassy hills and mossy stone banks with golden reeds, a timber deck on posts across still water with reflections, girder legs rising out of the reeds, lit caves cut into the hills with a lantern
vocabulary.below: under the pond, inside the wrong reflection: a drained sunken maze of rusty girders and stone walls, blue-green water light rippling across them, weed and roots hanging from the ceiling, lit cellar rooms with crates, shelves and a hanging lamp

anomaly.note: The 404 is data, never painted: chunks are painted clean; the preview and the game draw these tears over them in the anomaly state. Each tear is placed by the generator in the sky of an 'above' chunk.

kinds.cut: a rectangle of sky turned flat grey with torn, pixel-stepped edges
kinds.stretch: a strip of the picture smeared into vertical streaks from one row

note_inputs: Paint inputs are the style master only: a whole stage or concept given as a look reference gets copied, layout and all (24 Oct, the first anchor chunk redrew the concept).
